premises.text: Most people struggle with home gardening—wrong watering, plant choice/placement/sourcing, fertilizer—and many products use toxic chemicals
premises.evidence_span: We are overwatering, we are underwatering, we are just doing it wrong. Gardening is really hard

premises.text: Fully assembled, portable self-watering garden with built-in insulated reservoir can be brought anywhere without breakdown or tools
premises.evidence_span: We've created the first fully-assembled, self-watering garden that you can just bring anywhere with you. You never have to break it down

premises.text: Proprietary sub-irrigation hardware and materials let plants draw water efficiently from a reservoir so users need not water for about a week
premises.evidence_span: we've created a proprietary piece of hardware, specifically in the water reservoir, and the proprietary materials we're using to make water transfer. immensely efficient

premises.text: Coaching app and Grow team give climate-, season-, and location-aware answers plus photo-based proactive troubleshooting
premises.evidence_span: we have a coaching app to keep you active, engaged and get all your questions answered before you even know that you have them

premises.text: Accessories for vertical growing and cold frames enable small-space and year-round outdoor growing
premises.evidence_span: You can pop in accessories for vertical growing to maximize your space, as well as cold frames, so that way, if you're living in Chicago or New York, you can grow year-round

premises.text: Climate-curated planting plans are included with the planter via coaching subscription
premises.evidence_span: He's using our coaching subscription, which does include everything. He has curated this box based on his climate
